description.zh: 任务创建时间筛选条件的结束时间，只支持近90天的时间。
description.en: The end of the time range for filtering tasks by their creation time. Supports querying data from the last 90 days only.

description.zh: 文件名或者媒资id等，支持对TaskInput进行模糊查询，最大长度32。
description.en: A keyword for fuzzy matching against the TaskInput, such as a file name or Media ID. Max length: 32 characters.

description.zh: 最大可返回的媒体工作流任务实例数。取值范围：[1,100]，默认值：10。
description.en: The maximum number of media workflow instances to return. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.

description.zh: 连续分页查询时下一页的标记 （第一页没有）。
description.en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request.

description.zh: 任务创建时间筛选条件的开始时间，只支持近90天的时间。
description.en: The start of the time range for filtering tasks by their creation time. Supports querying data from the last 90 days only.

description.zh: 工作流模板ID。您可通过[智能媒体服务控制台](https://ims.console.aliyun.com/settings/workflow/list)> 配置管理 > 工作流模板，查看模板ID。

description.en: The name of the workflow template.

descriptions.zh: 本接口只返回近 90 天执行实例。
descriptions.en: This API only returns data from the last 90 days.
